query: What CGPA do I need to keep to avoid an academic warning?

retrieved.section: Margalla Institute of Technology: Academic Rules (2026 edition)

context.text:
[academic-rules-2026.md | 2. Academic warning]
2.1 A student whose cumulative grade point average (CGPA) falls below 2.00 at the end of a regular semester is placed on academic warning. 2.2 A student who remains on academic warning for three consecutive semesters is dropped from the programme.

[academic-rules-2026.md | Margalla Institute of Technology: Academic Rules (2026 edition)]
This edition replaces the 2023 edition for all students from the Fall 2026 semester.
